title: Exponential Time with an EXPCOM Oracle
statement: Every language decidable in time $2^{n^c}$ for some natural number $c$ is decidable in polynomial time with oracle access to the following language. Fix the machine coding and the machine code used in defining this language; a string belongs to the language exactly when it has the form $\langle\alpha,\langle x,1^m\rangle\rangle$ and the machine decoded from $\alpha$ halts on input $x$ after exactly $2^m$ steps with output $[\mathrm{true}]$.
replaced:
Every language in $\mathrm{EXP}$ belongs to $\mathsf{P}^{\mathrm{EXPCOM}}$, where
$\mathrm{EXPCOM}$ is the language of encodings of a machine code, an input, and a unary
time parameter for which the coded machine accepts that input within the corresponding
exponential time bound.
